caption: The drawing shows a small carousel-like structure set on a rectangular brown base. Four vertical striped posts, colored in blue and yellow, stand on the corners of the base and support a framework above. Two brown horses with riders are positioned side by side beneath the crossbars, facing opposite directions. One rider wears a green outfit with a tan hat, and the other rider is dressed in a red outfit with a white head covering. A third figure, standing next to the second horse, has long brown hair and is dressed in a long yellow garment. The scene is centered on a beige background bordered by a simple double-lined rectangle. The composition uses mainly earth tones, with blue and yellow accents on the posts and the riders' clothing adding contrast.
title: Pa. German Toy Merry-Go-Round
